headline: Bank of Industry Injects N644.9 Billion Into Nigerian Business Enterprises
summary: Nigeria's Bank of Industry announced it disbursed a record N644.9 billion to 12,501 commercial enterprises in 2025, creating or supporting 1.68 million jobs across the country.
why: Development bank disbursements are key to funding industrial capacity and non-oil manufacturing growth across Africa's major economies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Subsidized industrial lending supports employment and capital investments in local commercial manufacturing.
